Message:
md/raid5: fix new memory-reference bug in alloc_thread_groups.

In alloc_thread_groups, worker_groups is a pointer to an array,
not an array of pointers.
So
   worker_groups[i]
is wrong.  It should be
   &(*worker_groups)[i]
